_comment: Run-length map of the Transparency Seal's roman-numeral sections over the document links, in page order. Every heading on the seal page is an <h4>, so the hierarchy lives in the text prefix: 'II. Annual Financial Reports' is a section, 'a. FAR No.1 ...' a subsection of it. links.raw.json records only the nearest heading, so this restores each link's parent section. Regenerate with scripts/psc-data/browser/harvest-links.js.

titles.I: The agency's mandates and functions, names of its officials with their position and designation, and contact information
titles.III: DBM Approved Budget and Corresponding Targets
titles.IV: Major Projects, Programs and Activities, Beneficiaries, and Status of Implementation
titles.VI: QMS Certification of at least one core process by an international certifying body (ICB)
titles.VIII: Agency Review and Compliance Procedure of Statements and Financial Disclosure
